title: Hero V2
name: hero-v2
description: Content Fragment Model backing the EDS Hero V2 block (blocks/hero-v2) and all seven of its variants (base + 6 locked presets). Single shared model; variant-specific field locking/visibility is enforced in the Universal Editor component definition (blocks/hero-v2/_hero-v2.json), not in the model, because AEM Content Fragment Models cannot express per-consumer conditional requiredness. Field names match what blocks/hero-v2/hero-v2.js reads via the persisted GraphQL query (see docs/hero-block/persisted-query-hero-by-path.md).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.notes: Primary hero headline. Optional everywhere; rendered into a heading element by the block.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.notes: Background image, resolved through the DAM asset picker. Delivered to the block as _publishUrl / _dynamicUrl via the GraphQL ImageRef; getCfImageUrl() resolves it.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Alt
fields.notes: Image alt text. Optional; the block falls back to alt="" (decorative) when empty, per WCAG guidance.

fields.name: actions
fields.label: Actions
fields.notes: Up to two calls to action. Positional default: first = primary, second = static-light. actionLink is validated to a relative or https URL; the block additionally drops unsafe links (javascript:, data:, protocol-relative) at render via isSafeUrl.

fields.name: height
fields.label: Height
fields.notes: Drives layout only on the base (non-locked) block; a locked variant class overrides this value.

fields.name: textAlignment
fields.label: Text Alignment
fields.notes: Base-block only; overridden by a locked variant.

fields.name: imagePosition
fields.label: Image Position
fields.notes: Base-block only; hidden/not-applicable on Standard and Compact variants, locked to center on Tall variants.
